# Two builds of the same solution emit byte-identical images: nothing
# in the pipeline — discovery, generation, the toolchain run, the
# emitter — may leak timestamps, map order, or temp paths into the
# artifact.
[short] skip 'drives the go toolchain'

sdl build -o out1.json $SDLREPO/examples/pingpong
sdl build -o out2.json $SDLREPO/examples/pingpong
cmp out1.json out2.json
